messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/amount", "title": "Refund amount", "text": "The refund for a unit is what was paid for that unit: its price minus its share of any discount. The shares are fixed once, when the order is recorded, and never recalculated: when a paid total is split among identical units, each unit gets the total divided by the number of units, rounded down to the smallest unit of the currency, and what is left over is added one smallest unit at a time to the last units, so no unit is refunded more than its price. Shipping charges are not part of the amount."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/remaining", "title": "Each unit is refunded once", "text": "Each unit is refunded at most once, in full. A unit that was already refunded cannot be refunded again. A request for more units than are left is not paid; the assistant can offer the units that remain."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text: I found three items in your bedding order. The shop’s records show two have been received back, so I’ve proposed a refund of **BRL 142.80** for those two. Please confirm using the button on the proposal card. The wool blanket hasn’t been recorded as received back, so it isn’t included (refund-policy/v1/return).
The customer confirmed request prop-e19222327ada46c5 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.
Your refund of **BRL 142.80** has been processed. Receipt number: **R-00000001**.
That’s fine for now. I’ll send the wool blanket back later.
